calibration_status: provisional; five historical tile samples, executing-agent diagnostic labels, human calibration pending

rationale.source_margin_fraction: Provisional 3 percent: historical Bastion has only 16/1024 px right margin versus the 31 px floor; original Comet has 33 px. Reject the known insufficient-frame sample before trimming.
rationale.car_aspect_relative_error: Provisional tolerance around W6 length/width; includes wheel silhouettes but refuses gross distortion. Never stretch to pass.
rationale.principal_axis_max_degrees: Horizontal major-axis gate only. Nose direction and camera projection are semantic questions.
rationale.tile_edge_mean_max: Registry conservative provisional 8 percent per-channel full-range MAD. Source and final are both recorded; only exported shipping pixels gate acceptance, separately per axis.
rationale.tile_edge_peak_max: Provisional full-range peak delta, fitted to five agent-inspected 2x2 shipping-size previews: visible ice discontinuity 0.447 versus no clear seam on asphalt 0.369. Human and held-out calibration pending.
rationale.tile_autocorrelation_max: Provisional 0.35: historical asphalt measures 0.956 and oil 0.412 versus anonymous P1 asphalt 0.040. Nontrivial circular shifts on a 128-square luminance sample; fitted diagnostic separation, not held-out human calibration.
rationale.palette_p90_delta_e: CIE Lab nearest role colour with derived material shades; diagnostic coarse mismatch gate, not an indexed-colour promise.
rationale.vlm_confidence_min: Low confidence routes to review. High confidence never authorizes acceptance, especially before human calibration.
